basic_details.job_title: Rail Wheel Factory (RWF) Sports Quota Recruitment 2026 Notification Out – Apply Offline for 15 Sportsperson Posts
basic_details.organization_name: Rail Wheel Factory (RWF), Yelahanka, Bangalore - Ministry of Railways
basic_details.short_information: Rail Wheel Factory (RWF), Yelahanka, Bangalore, a unit under the Ministry of Railways, has released a notification inviting applications from eligible sportspersons against Sports Quota (Open Advertisement) for the year 2026-27. A total of 15 posts are available across Level-2 (GP 1900) and Level-1 (GP 1800) in disciplines such as Badminton, Table Tennis, Cricket, Hockey, Football, and Kabaddi. Interested candidates can apply offline on or before 24 August 2026.

IPOs/DDs issued before the date of issue of the notification or after the closing date will not be accepted. Applications not accompanied by the Examination Fee will be summarily rejected. how_to_apply: Download the notification and Application Form (Annexure-I) from www.rwf.indianrailways.gov.in.
Print the application form on good quality white A4 (210 x 297 mm) paper.
Fill the form in your own handwriting using a blue ballpoint pen, in English or Hindi only.
Affix a recent passport-size photograph and provide the required signatures, left thumb impression, and personal identification marks.
Attach self-attested copies of all required documents and the prescribed Examination Fee (IPO/DD).
Write "Application against Sports Quota (Open Advertisement) dated 25.07.2026 - Recruitment for the year 2026-27" on top of the sealed envelope.

Send the application by post to: The Assistant Personnel Officer, Personnel Department, Rail Wheel Factory (Ministry of Railways), Administrative Building, Yelahanka, Bangalore 560064, or drop it in the Drop Box at the Personnel Department office (2nd Floor) at the same address, before the closing date and time.
important_instructions: Applications received after the closing date and time will be summarily rejected; RWF will not be responsible for postal or any other delay. Applications not in the prescribed format, incomplete, without signature/left thumb impression, in a language other than English/Hindi, or without required documents and fee, will be rejected. Candidates applying for more than one game/event must submit separate applications with separate Examination Fees. Candidates serving in any Government Department/PSU (including Railways) must submit a declaration of having intimated their employer, and an NOC at the time of trials, failing which their candidature will be cancelled. Candidates debarred from RRB/RRC exams should not apply unless their debarment period is over by the closing date. No TA/DA or accommodation will be provided for document verification/trials (SC/ST candidates are eligible for free rail travel in second class for this purpose). Canvassing in any form will lead to disqualification. Selected candidates will undergo a probation period of 2 years and must fill and sign a Service Bond (Annexure-E) committing to serve in their sports field for a minimum of 5 years. Candidates recruited against Sports Quota can participate in other sporting/professional activities only with prior sanction of the Government.

Candidates with a background in athletics or team sports can also explore more Railway Recruitment 2026 and Sports Quota Government Jobs across India. Applicants based in Karnataka can check the latest Karnataka Government Jobs and Bangalore Government Jobs for upcoming vacancies. Candidates holding a 10th/12th pass or ITI qualification can also browse more ITI Government Jobs and 10th Pass Government Jobs matching their qualification.

content_sections.heading: RWF Sports Quota Recruitment 2026-27 Minimum Sports Norms
content_sections.text: Sportspersons must fulfil the minimum sports achievement norms prescribed for the level they are applying for, based on representation, ranking, or position achieved in recognized championships. Additional sport-specific norms apply for Cricket, Hockey, Badminton, Table Tennis, Football, and Kabaddi, including current Annual All India/World Rankings for Badminton and Table Tennis, and specific representation criteria for Cricket and Hockey, as detailed in the full notification. International Championships for recruitment purposes are categorized as Category-A (Olympic Games), Category-B (World Cup, World Championships, Asian Games, Commonwealth Games, Youth Olympics, Champions Trophy-Hockey), and Category-C (Commonwealth Championships, Asian Championships/Asia Cup, SAF Games, USIC/World Railways Championships, World University Games).

rows.minimum_sports_norms: Represented the country in Category-B championships/events; OR at least 3rd position in Category-C championships/events, Senior/Youth/Junior National Championships, or National Games (Indian Olympic Association); OR at least 3rd position in All India Inter-University Championship; OR 1st position in Federation Cup Championships (Senior)

Represented the country in Category-C championships/events; OR at least 3rd position in Federation Cup Championships (Senior); OR represented a State/equivalent unit with at least 8th position in Senior National Championships (except marathon and cross country)
